fields.title: Blepharoplasty
fields.bodyHtml:
Blepharoplasty is a surgical procedure to correct and reshape the eyelids. It makes the gaze livelier, more open and more expressive, addressing the changes that come with age and various aesthetic concerns. Blepharoplasty is very popular in Israel, where operations are carried out by leading plastic surgeons using the most advanced techniques.

Types and methods of blepharoplasty

Israeli clinics perform the following types of blepharoplasty:

  • Upper eyelid blepharoplasty: removes hooding and drooping of the upper eyelids. During the operation excess fat and skin are removed, and the muscle tissue of the upper eyelid may also be reshaped.
  • Lower eyelid blepharoplasty: addresses puffiness, herniated fat and bags under the eyes. The operation is performed in two ways:
    • Subciliary blepharoplasty: the incision is made along the lash line, allowing the surgeon to remove fat and excess skin.
    • Transconjunctival blepharoplasty: the incision is made on the inner surface of the eyelid, allowing excess fat to be removed or redistributed.
  • Full blepharoplasty: a combined operation performed on the upper and lower eyelids at the same time.
  • Canthopexy: an operation to lift the corners of the eyelids and tighten the supporting ligaments. The procedure lifts the lower eyelid area, corrects the shape and expression of the eyes and removes drooping of the lid.

Indications and recovery

Specialists list the following indications for eyelid blepharoplasty:

  • Hooding of the eyelids
  • Ptosis
  • Drooping of the upper eyelids
  • Asymmetry of the eyes
  • Age-related changes around the eyelids
  • Bags of fat under the eyes
  • Loose skin around the eyes
  • Papillomas
  • Wrinkles around the eyes
  • Keratitis
  • Presbyopia
  • Burn injuries of the eyes

Patients also choose blepharoplasty when they wish to change the shape of the eyes and make the gaze more open and expressive.

The procedure and recovery

Blepharoplasty may be performed for medical or for cosmetic reasons. The innovative technologies used in Israel allow the operation to be carried out as a day case with a minimal recovery period. Depending on the type and extent of the surgery, the operation is performed under local or general anaesthetic.

For a week after the operation patients may have swelling, which gradually subsides. Full recovery takes about two weeks.

Why choose Israel for blepharoplasty?

Israeli specialists in plastic surgery are highly qualified and widely experienced, which allows them to guarantee patients complete safety and excellent aesthetic results. The advantages of choosing Israeli clinics for blepharoplasty:

  • The use of advanced techniques and technologies.
  • A high level of skill and experience among surgeons.
  • A short recovery period.
  • The option of having the operation as a day case.
  • A comprehensive approach to diagnosis and treatment, including consultations and follow-up.

Blepharoplasty in Israel gives good results even in the most difficult cases.

fields.title: Blepharospasm
fields.bodyHtml:
Blepharospasm is a neurological disorder marked by involuntary contractions of the eyelid muscles, which leads to frequent blinking and closing of the eyes. The condition can considerably impair quality of life, causing discomfort and difficulty with everyday activities.

Diagnosis of blepharospasm

  1. Detailed review of the medical history: the doctor talks with the patient, gathering information about symptoms, previous illnesses, treatment and other factors that may affect the condition.
  2. Visual examination: the ophthalmologist examines the patient's eyes and assesses the frequency and intensity of blinking and the state of the eyelid muscles.
  3. Electromyography (EMG): a test that measures the electrical activity of the eyelid muscles and helps identify abnormal muscle contractions.
  4. Neurological examination: carried out to rule out other neurological disorders that may cause similar symptoms.
  5. Ophthalmoscopy: allows the state of the optic nerve, the vessels of the fundus and the retina to be assessed, in order to rule out other possible causes of the symptoms.

Treatment of blepharospasm

  1. Drug therapy:
    • Botulinum toxin (Botox): one of the most effective treatments for blepharospasm. Injections of botulinum toxin into the eyelid muscles temporarily block the nerve impulses causing the spasms, which improves the condition.
    • Anticholinergic drugs: may be used to reduce muscle activity and ease symptoms.
  2. Physiotherapy:
    • Massage and eyelid exercises: help relax the muscles and reduce the frequency of spasms.
    • Warm compresses: help relax the muscles and ease discomfort.
  3. Surgery:
    • Myectomy: an operation to remove part of the eyelid muscle in order to reduce involuntary contractions. Used where other treatments have not worked.
  4. Neurological treatment:
    • Drugs acting on the nervous system: in some cases medicines that act on the central nervous system are prescribed to control symptoms.
  5. Psychological therapy:
    • Consultations with a psychologist or psychotherapist: can help the patient cope with the psychological discomfort and stress associated with blepharospasm.

Advantages of treating blepharospasm in Israel

  1. A high level of medical expertise: Israel has leading specialists in ophthalmology and neurology with many years of experience and exceptional skills.
  2. Modern equipment: clinics are equipped with advanced diagnostic and treatment devices, which allows highly accurate investigation and effective treatment.
  3. An individual approach: every patient is given a personal treatment plan that takes account of the nature of the condition and the patient's general health.
  4. Innovative treatments: the use of the most modern methods and medicines, including botulinum toxin and other innovative therapeutic approaches.
  5. Comfortable conditions: patients can count on a high level of comfort and service during treatment and recovery.

Treatment of blepharospasm in Israel gives patients access to high-quality medical care and considerably improves their quality of life.

fields.title: Heart block
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Heart block is a serious disturbance in the conduction of electrical impulses in the heart, which can slow the heartbeat or stop it altogether. The condition varies in severity and arises from a range of causes. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of treating heart block in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Heart block may be temporary or permanent, and correct treatment requires the type and degree of block to be established precisely. Modern medicine offers various methods of diagnosing heart block, including:

  • Electrocardiography (ECG): the most widely used and non-invasive method, recording the electrical activity of the heart. An ECG can reveal signs of heart block and determine its type.
  • 24-hour ECG monitoring (Holter monitoring): continuous ECG recording over 24 hours to detect intermittent block or infrequent conduction disturbances.
  • Echocardiography: ultrasound that allows the structure and function of the heart to be assessed, structural causes of block to be identified and the general state of the heart muscle to be evaluated.
  • Electrophysiological study: an invasive method carried out with catheters passed into the heart. It establishes precisely where the block is and what type it is, which allows treatment to be planned more accurately.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of heart block depends on its type and degree and on the patient's general condition. The main treatments include:

  • Drug therapy: doctors may prescribe medicines such as antiarrhythmic drugs or agents that stimulate cardiac conduction, in order to restore a normal heart rhythm.
  • Pacemaker implantation: patients with serious or permanent heart block may need a pacemaker — a device that generates electrical impulses and maintains a normal heart rate.
  • Catheter ablation: a minimally invasive procedure in which abnormal areas of heart tissue are destroyed using catheters passed through the blood vessels.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a medical centre of world class, known for its advanced technologies and experienced specialists in cardiology and electrophysiology. The advantages of treating heart block in Israel include:

  • Leading specialists: Israeli cardiologists and electrophysiologists have rich experience and knowledge, which makes treatment highly effective.
  • Use of advanced technology: medical institutions in Israel apply advanced methods of diagnosing and treating heart block, which allows the best results to be achieved.
  • An individual approach to treatment: every patient is offered individual and comprehensive care that takes account of their particular circumstances and needs.

Conclusion

Heart block is a serious disturbance of cardiac conduction that requires accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Modern methods of diagnosis and advanced treatments such as pacemaker implantation or catheter ablation make it possible to deal with heart block successfully and restore normal cardiac function. Israel, as a world leader in cardiology, provides high-quality medical care and has advanced technology for the effective treatment of heart block. If you have problems with your heart, do not delay in consulting a specialist and obtaining qualified help to maintain the health of your heart and your body as a whole.

fields.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: an integrated approach to treatment in Israel

Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig's disease, is a serious progressive disease of the motor neurones that leads to loss of muscle function and, ultimately, to complete paralysis. Israel takes a comprehensive approach to the treatment and support of patients with ALS, aimed at slowing the progression of the disease and improving their quality of life.

Diagnosis of ALS:

  1. Neurological examination: assessment of motor neurone function, muscle strength, reflexes and coordination.
  2. Electromyography (EMG) and nerve conduction studies: to identify abnormalities in the motor neurones.
  3. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): to rule out other causes of the symptoms.
  4. Laboratory tests: to rule out other conditions whose symptoms may resemble ALS.

Methods of treating ALS in Israel:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Drug therapy approved for ALS, which can slow the progression of the disease to a modest degree.
    • Medicines to manage symptoms such as muscle spasms, pain, problems with saliva and breathing difficulties.
  2. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation:
    • Maintaining mobility and preventing joint contractures.
    • Breathing exercises and the use of assisted breathing devices where needed.
  3. Speech and language therapy:
    • Help in preserving the ability to swallow and speak.
    • Training in the use of alternative means of communication as speech is lost.
  4. Psychological support:
    • Counselling for patients and their families to help them adjust to living with the disease.
  5. Nutrition and diet:
    • Dietary advice to prevent weight loss and ensure adequate nutrition.
  6. Use of adaptive devices:
    • Individually chosen aids to ease everyday activity and improve quality of life.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: a team of specialists including neurologists, physiotherapists, speech therapists and psychologists works together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Advanced research: Israel takes an active part in international clinical trials of new drugs and treatments for ALS, giving patients access to innovative therapies.
  • Individual care: treatment and support are tailored to each patient's particular needs, taking account of their condition and preferences.

Israel approaches ALS comprehensively, giving patients access to the most advanced treatment and support, which helps them lead fuller lives even with this serious condition.
